howItWorks.heading: How does Munsit work?
howItWorks.description: From recording the lecture to reviewing and testing your understanding, Munsit makes your learning journey easier and smarter in four steps.

1.title: Start recording your lecture
1.text: Record your lecture live and focus on the lecturer instead of writing down every word.

2.title: Let Munsit analyze
2.text: Munsit turns the lecture audio into written text and helps you mark the key information automatically.

3.title: Review your lecture smartly
3.text: Get organized summaries and return to the important information easily, so you review and understand faster.

4.title: Test your understanding and progress
4.text: Test yourself with questions from your lecture content, and use the smart assistant to understand the hard parts.

useCases.heading: Munsit is with you at every step of your learning journey.
useCases.description: Whether you're in a lecture, studying or preparing for an exam, Munsit helps you learn smartly and make the most of your time.

1.title: Focus on the explanation… and leave the rest to Munsit.
1.text: Instead of being busy writing every word, focus on the lecturer while Munsit helps you record the lecture and turn it into organized text you can return to anytime.

2.title: Organized studying without wasted time.
2.text: Return to your lectures easily and review the key information through smart summaries and automatically marked points, so you take in the content faster.

3.title: Test your understanding before you walk into the exam.
3.text: Review with interactive questions drawn from your lectures, and use the smart assistant to understand the hard parts and strengthen your level.

faq.heading: Still have questions about Munsit?
faq.description: We've gathered answers to the most important questions so you can start your journey with Munsit clearly.

1.question: What is Munsit?
1.answer: Munsit is a learning platform that uses AI to help you record and transcribe lectures, organize information, and create summaries and interactive questions that make studying and review easier.

2.question: Does Munsit turn lectures into written text?
2.answer: Yes. Munsit helps you turn the lecture audio into written text that you can return to and review easily.

3.question: How does Munsit identify the important information?
3.answer: It uses AI techniques to analyze the lecture content and help mark the important points so you can focus on them while reviewing.

4.question: Can I create a summary of my lecture?
4.answer: Yes. Munsit helps you organize the lecture content and turn it into clear summaries that make reviewing the main ideas easier.

5.question: Can Munsit help me prepare for exams?
5.answer: Munsit helps you review with interactive questions based on your lecture content, so you can test your understanding and find the points you need to revisit.

6.question: Can I ask Munsit about something I don't understand?
6.answer: Yes. You can use the smart learning assistant to ask about difficult information and get an explanation that helps you understand it better.
